subject: Ranked Choice Voting - Ballot Receipt
body:
Dear {username},

Thank you for participating in the Student Union election!

Your ranked choice ballot has been successfully submitted.

YOUR RANKINGS:
{rankings}

For questions about the election, please contact the Elections Committee.

Best regards,
Student Union Elections Committee
